 Cooper & Quinn LLP
 Pasadena, TX
 Phone 832-555-2058
 Letter of Representation
02/19/2025
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1467
Our client: Karen Smith
Date of loss: 01/06/2025
Dear Claims Representative:
This lteter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with
the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our
client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for
them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and
do not contact our client directly, whether by phone, mail, or in person.
We ask that you provide a written statement of the liability coverage limits under the
policy issued to the driver involved in the collision, along with the declarations
page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.
We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This
includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics records, recorded
statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, and any repair or total-loss records
for the vehicles involved. Please ensure that none of this material is altered,
discarded, or repaired without prior notice to our office.
Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm within fourteen days that the
requested steps have been taken.
Sincerely,
Matthew Day
Cooper & Quinn LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
